map.理想气体压强（P = nRT / V） 使用指南: Ideal Gas Pressure (P = nRT / V) User Guide
map.输入物质的量 n、温度 T 与体积 V（连同气体常数 R），由理想气体状态方程求: Enter the amount of substance n, temperature T and volume V (with the gas constant R) and find the gas pressure P from the ideal gas law; used to estimate the internal pressure of gas cylinders, containers and reactors.
map.由理想气体状态方程求给定体积下的气体压强。: Gas pressure at a given volume from the ideal gas law.
map.由 n、T、V 求理想气体压强 P=nRT/V。: Find the ideal gas pressure P = nRT/V from n, T and V.
map.标准态、气瓶压强估算。: Standard state and gas cylinder pressure estimation.
map.与玻意耳/查理定律联用。: Use together with Boyle's law and Charles's law.
map.：T 273→373 K：P 升至 138.3 kPa。: : T 273 -> 373 K: P rises to 138.3 kPa.
map.用 m³（非 L），R=8.314 J/molK；用 L 时 R=8.314 L: Use m3 (not L) with R = 8.314 J/molK; when using L, R = 8.314 L*kPa/molK.
map.低压高温近似理想，高压或近液化需真实气体方程。: Low pressure and high temperature approximate ideal behavior; high pressure or near liquefaction requires a real gas equation.
